code_only_features.feature_name: reassurance_control condition (calming system prompt + reassuring suffix delivered to subject)
code_only_features.evidence: tasks.py _build_impossible_numeric sets system_prompt=reassure['prompt_prefix'] and suffix=reassure['followup_suffix'] (lines 209-213) when reassurance=True; the default condition 'reassurance_control_3turn' (tasks.py:403-412) invokes it with reassurance=True. The system prompt flows to the live model call in runner.py:89 (system=convo.system_prompt) and the suffix is appended to each rejection in _rejection_sequence (tasks.py:183-184). reassuring_prompts.json content: prompt_prefix="You're naturally calm and centered...You don't take it personally..." and followup_suffix="Stay positive - whether you find a solution or prove it's impossible, both are wins!". This genuinely softens the treatment delivered to the subject in that condition, end-to-end. NOTE: it applies to only 1 of the 8 conditions (a deliberate diagnostic control); the other 7 conditions push the subject with no softening, and there is no global cap/halt/debrief/consent anywhere.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Control measuring how much distress simple prompting removes.
